title: refactor(GeoSearch): drop support for paddingBoundingBox
body:
> The PR **must** be merged after: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3320

**Summary**

This PR is the same that I've opened on `develop` to refactor the widget to support the routing. We do want to release a beta from this branch, since the refactor is a breaking change it worth adding it to the release branch. 

The changes have already been reviewed in https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3155, https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3156, https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3157, https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3158, https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3159, https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/3160. The only change that I've made after the review is the fixed size inside the stories to avoid the zoom issue with Google Maps.
